verdict.rationale: Cooley is a law firm whose user-facing product is the Cooley GO template and document-generator site. Plugging external MCP servers in as a tool-using client is an agent or AI-assistant axis, not a fair question for a legal-services firm or document generator. The firm's internal AI drafting tools (prompt-based S-1 updates) show no MCP client capability, so the exception does not apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
